profiles.reason: No native production evidence for authenticated synchronous cross-world function proxies on public WKWebView. Existing M0 probe demonstrates shared-DOM reply forgery.

profiles.semantics: explicitly adapted renderer API; NOT general Electron contextBridge
profiles.bridge: host-audited allowlisted async IPC in WKWebView page world; local synchronous listener disposal only
profiles.trust: native WKFrameInfo/frame/document/generation and per-operation grants; page readable values are not authentication
limitations: original preload is not generally executed with identical contextBridge semantics
renderer asset unchanged only when verified by hash
source unchanged does not imply binary distribution unchanged
